name: sunlit-gouache
description: Sunlit Gouache — bright pastel travel-painting illustration in opaque gouache on textured paper. Chunky flat brushstrokes, dappled cream-and-butter-yellow sunlight, sky-blue + sage-green + terracotta accents, figures seen from behind walking into a one-point-perspective focal light, with overhead hanging elements (awning, flags, wires, lanterns) creating depth. Trigger when user says /sunlit-gouache, asks for a "sunlit gouache illustration", "painterly travel scene", "gouache café/market/temple/station scene", or a new piece in this bright pastel painted-light style.
